name: pjb
about: Navigator probe pack-joint-burst (decisions 'After the bench-retention probes'): one burst over all eight gen batch 1 mechanics at once, 50 fights each on the three elites (400 games), net teacher @hpb0.01@tsl1, two seeds; read one turn deep @tsl1 on the bench (gen batch 1, elites, first 1000 starts x 4 seeds) against the zero-shot 10-29 net. Question: do a pack's own games keep the OppCard-Vulnerable edge the single-mechanic bursts lost, while repairing the punish-an-action family? The table scores AttackLoss-Damage x Nob (half the zero-shot cost cut at 2 se passes); the navigator reads OppCard-Vulnerable x Sentries and the rest by hand.
